biggest_catch: Userlytics' official page confirms payments every 15 days for approved tests - but publishes no worker pay figures, so there is no concrete official pay to verify.
catches: No official pay figures: all dollar-per-test claims come from third parties, not Userlytics.
Only client-approved tests are paid - unapproved feedback earns nothing.
Test invites are random and limited; Userlytics says it 'cannot tell you how often you will get an invite.'
One account per tester - duplicates are removed with their payments and can trigger a permanent ban.
Your test recordings may be used in Userlytics marketing material unless you decline to sign up.

c1.evidence: Userlytics' official tester page publishes no worker pay figures - only third-party sources quote per-test amounts.

c3.evidence: Free tester account; no upfront fee.

c4.evidence: Official timing exists but no official concrete worker pay figures - fails the concrete-pay requirement.
